_purpose: tasks.md T-003 Planned Files declares this tree: 'a Project Context
declaring components, a Registry with a matched ineligible Capability,
the assembled trigger-fragment fixture this signal source produces, and
a companion fixture confirming the existing ship-time recheck still
independently Blocks when the intake-time evaluation did not itself flag
the component'. It was declared but never created; both twins built
their fixtures inline via mktemp/heredoc instead, which is also why two
cross-model slots reported that the inputs behind the assertions could
not be read (T-003 Anthropic slot, Minor). Reading both twins from ONE
file is also what keeps them from silently modelling the Registry
differently -- the divergence a previous round had to fix by hand.
